highLevelGoal: Reopen Orca-Strator V1 as NOT YET QUALIFIED and perform a deep runtime-integration hardening campaign until the real production path works end-to-end: watcher->loop->executor->result->loop->Sol wake wired in production, correct Windows/WSL/Git/browser/recovery/control semantics, and a real qualification tier that proves the pipeline with real Git, real child-process executors, and durable result manifests.

checkpoint.summary: V1 is re-opened as NOT YET QUALIFIED. The prior V1_ROADMAP_COMPLETE / '136 tests passing' status is NOT proof of real functionality: the existing tests are simulation tests that manually invoke internal transition methods (onDispatchDetected/onExecutorCompleted) and use fake executors/mock browsers. Production wiring was absent: WatcherService had no callback into LoopService, ExecutorService.onExit never called back into the loop, ceiling/exit were mapped to GOAL_COMPLETE, startup reconciler duplicated active runs, and problem states were hidden as IDLE. Change 009 (openspec/changes/009-v1-runtime-integration-hardening/) documents findings A-R and the corrective design. Implementation of the real pipeline and the highest-value correctness fixes is in progress.
checkpoint.lastCompletedTask: Create Change 009 OpenSpec (proposal, design, delta spec, tasks) and reopen V1 as NOT YET QUALIFIED
checkpoint.lastVerification: Change 009 artifacts written; findings A-R catalogued with concrete corrective design. No implementation changes merged yet; broad baseline test run intentionally skipped per campaign policy.

nextAction: Implement Finding A (wire watcher->loop->executor->result->loop->Sol wake in production via explicit callbacks) and Finding G/M/N (correct loop semantics, startup rehydration, status visibility) using focused tests, then proceed through B-F, H-L, O-P, and the real qualification tier Q, committing continuously. Keep simulation tests as regression coverage but stop treating them as proof of real autonomy.

blockers.summary: Prior V1_ROADMAP_COMPLETE claim is unsubstantiated: production pipeline was not actually wired and ceiling/exit were mapped to GOAL_COMPLETE. Real end-to-end autonomy has not been demonstrated on this machine.
blockers.evidence: apps/controller/src/app.ts wires WatcherService without a loop callback; LoopService takes watcherService but never stores/calls it; ExecutorService.onExit updates dispatchStore but never calls loopService.onExecutorCompleted; loop-service.onExecutorCompleted maps ceiling/wall-clock/exit to GOAL_COMPLETE; StartupReconciler calls startRun() on already-active runs; RunStore.getActiveRun excludes problem states.
blockers.nextAction: Resolve findings A-R per Change 009 and add a real qualification tier (Q) proving the assembled pipeline end-to-end.

blockers.summary: Real qualification may be limited by absence of locally installed Kimi Code/Codex CLIs, Chromium, ChatGPT auth, or Tailscale on this machine. Such gaps must be reported as UNQUALIFIED/MANUALLY-QUALIFIED rather than faked.
blockers.evidence: Qualification design requires real temp git remotes, real child-process executors, optional Chromium provisioning, optional ChatGPT auth, optional Tailscale.
blockers.nextAction: Run real qualification tiers where the machine permits; explicitly mark gaps UNQUALIFIED.
